title: calamintha nepeta var. byzantina
intro: Calamintha nepeta var. byzantina, commonly known as Byzantine camphor, is a species of flowering plant in the mint family. It is a low-growing, woody perennial with a silvery-gray foliage and small blue-purple flowers that are rich in essential oils. The health benefits of Byzantine camphor include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which can help alleviate digestive issues, anxiety, and insomnia. The plant's bioactive constituents include camphor, borneol, and other terpenes that exhibit therapeutic actions such as relaxing the nervous system, reducing pain, and promoting calmness.
